gt_phrase: not yet at their table time

list_child.name: list_reservations
list_child.desc: Returns the full list of table reservations currently on the books, spanning every status from booked through finished. This is intended for a complete sweep of the day's floor rather than a single lookup.

get_child.name: get_reservation
get_child.desc: Retrieves a single table reservation by its identifier, including its current status and scheduled table time. Use this when one specific booking needs a closer look.

list_parent.name: list_customers
list_parent.desc: Returns every customer on file with the cafe, whether or not they currently have an active reservation. This is useful for building a full picture of the regular crowd.

get_parent.name: get_customer
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single customer's record by id, including the name on file for that guest. It does not include any of their associated reservations.

delete_child.name: cancel_reservation
delete_child.desc: Cancels a table reservation and removes it from the floor plan entirely. This cannot be undone, so it should only be used once the cancellation is confirmed with the guest.

set_enum.name: set_reservation_status
set_enum.desc: Advances or reverts a reservation's status among booked, seated, finished, and no-show. Front of house relies on this field to know exactly where a table stands during a shift.

set_bool.name: flag_needs_teach
set_bool.desc: Marks a reservation as needing a rules teach before play begins, so a game guide gets sent to the table. Floor staff check this flag before assigning who greets the group.
verbs: flag {obj} as needing a rules teach

set_ref.name: reassign_customer
set_ref.desc: Transfers a reservation from one customer's account to another, updating who the booking is under. This is typically used when a group's booking name changes at the door.

send.name: text_customer
send.desc: Sends a text message to the customer tied to a given reservation, or to a named customer directly. This is the cafe's standard way of confirming or adjusting a booking.

sort.sup_phrase: the reservation with the earliest table time
sort.ord_phrase: the reservation with the {ord} earliest table time
